fixes.explanation: Relatives is it. Abraham says the servant will go to "…my country and my kindred…" and kindred means family. So Isaac's wife is to come from Abraham's own people. And the servant has to find her without any group chat, friend. I'd have wanted a map and a snack.

A gate, huh? Good guess, friend, but this verse doesn't put the camels there. The servant makes them kneel near the well outside the town, right when the women go out to draw water. I think that's smart. Ten camels, one well, and everybody who needs water has to walk right up to him. That's not a coincidence, that's a plan. Even I park by the oven when I want company.

problems.problem: The text does not say the search was long. Rebekah arrives before the servant finishes praying.
The explanation is flat and generic, repeating the answer without much of Papa Dorin's personality.
